text:
maria: Quick sync — prepping launch posts + a compact benchmark narrative for the Sparkplug seed. Goal: test two free-credit sizes + one prompt-template pack, measure 7-day activation (first successful generation + second session). Need copy, tracking, and webinar CTA routing. Who can own what?

aj: I can wire the tracking events. What do you want as the canonical events/props? I can push schema to analytics and flag experiments.

maria: Thanks. Minimal events: `signup_source`, `experiment_cohort`, `credit_amount`, `prompt_pack_id`, `first_generation_success`, `second_session`. payload example: 
```
{ "user_id": "...", "experiment_cohort": "sparkplug_credit_a", "credit_amount": 100 }
```
Use `activation_nudge_shown` and `activation_complete` as well.

sam: Proposal for cohorts: A = 100 credits + core prompt pack, B = 300 credits + curated prompt pack, C = control (no bonus). Segment by signup path: docs-onboarding, webinar-reg, organic. Primary metric: % with activation_complete within 7 days. Secondary: tokens used in first session.

leah: Draft launch post copy (two short variants):
Variant short: "Sparkplug is live — get started with free credits and ready-made prompt packs to prototype features fast. Join our kickoff webinar for tips. → [link]"
Variant narrative: "Ship LLM features faster: Sparkplug seed gives you free credits + prompt packs tuned for product use-cases. We’ll show live examples in our webinar — register now. → [link]"
Also a microcopy for the credit email: "You’ve got free credits ready — try our starter prompts to see instant results. Need help? Join our webinar.
"

taylor: For inbound routing: if someone signs up from webinar-reg UTM, route them to the webinar nurture flow and tag `lead_source:webinar` in CRM. For sparkplug cohorts, add `campaign:sparkplug_seed_2026`. Can we get UTM guidelines attached to the post links?

aj: Yep — will add UTM params (`utm_campaign=sparkplug_seed_2026&utm_source=post&utm_medium=social`) and wire experiment flags. I’ll add a boolean `sparkplug_exposed=true` in user props for cohort assignment. Timeline: schema + tracking ready by EOD Wednesday, rollout flags by Friday.

leah: Small copy tweak request: make CTA on the long variant "Reserve my seat" for webinar links — better conversion in prior tests. Also recommend a 3-email webinar nurture (reminder, tips, last chance).

maria: Love it. Final asks:
- @aj: push schema + experiment flags (due Wed EOD)
- @leah: finalize 2 post variants + email 3-pack (due Thu noon)
- @sam: confirm cohort sizes and sampling logic (due Thu EOD)
- @taylor: confirm CRM routing + UTM checklist (due Thu EOD)
Ops note: plan to run for 2 weeks, then snapshot benchmark (activation rate, tokens, retention).

ops-bot: Created campaign record `marketing::sparkplug_seed_2026` and scheduled reminder on 1834578000.

maria: Thanks everyone — dropping a short brief in Google Drive and will ping when assets land. :thumbsup:
